Subject: Claim Decision Regarding Your Collision Coverage

Dear {CLAIMANT_NAME},

We have completed the review of your claim regarding the collision that occurred on 2026-04-12. We are pleased to inform you that your claim is approved.

The loss is covered under your collision coverage. According to your policy, [COLL-1] "We will pay for direct and accidental losses to your covered auto caused by collision, minus the collision deductible shown in the Declarations."

The payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued to you. This amount is after your {DEDUCTIBLE} deductible.

As a next step, payment of {PAYOUT} will be issued within 5 business days.

If you have any questions regarding this decision, please contact us.

ClaimPilot Claims Team
